limitations: The connected GitHub write surface accepts repository source and metadata but does not expose organization repository creation or release-asset upload.
The execution container cannot reach GitHub transport endpoints, so the opaque archive bytes cannot be transferred through git or gh from this runtime.
Exact archive bytes remain in the persistent file library; this repository commits their immutable checksums, byte lengths, provenance, and non-destructive disposition.
A checksum anchor is recovery evidence, not a claim that every archived commit exists in a live repository.

policy.conflict_resolution: Preserve current canonical history, compare archived intent with live repositories, and add only a semantic union through ordinary forward commits and pull requests.

scan.test_fixture_exception: One separately reviewed MCP test archive contains an intentionally rejected credential-in-URL fixture; that archive is not part of this three-archive publication ledger.
